# Error-coefficient landscape of the rank-7 census (`r <= 7`, `n <= 44`)

The shipped table keeps one witness per `(n, k, S_k gate)` class.  This one re-sweeps the same parents and keeps, per class and per **check rank**, the witness with the smallest leading error coefficient `a3` (undetected, harmful 3-sets of injections: `P_fail ~ a3 p^3`).  1201 classes; every witness re-verified from its columns.

## What the one-witness table hid

* classes compared with `classification/legacy/rank7_census/catalog/sk_classes_r7.json`: 1201 (0 shipped classes missing here, 0 here but not there)
* classes occurring at more than one check rank: 137
* classes whose shipped witness is NOT the minimum-`a3` circuit at its own rank: 451
* classes with a strictly smaller `a3` at a different rank: 137 (higher rank: 137, lower rank: 0)
* classes with a strictly smaller `a3` anywhere: 460

## Per class

`a3` by rank lists the minimum coefficient at each check rank the class occurs at; `shipped` is the rank and coefficient of the witness the shipped table kept.
